definitions.construction: Smooth an arbitrary feasible rule by covariance-matched Gaussian convolution; average the smoothed rule over nested tangential boxes ordered by the incidence poset; project each stratum through the \(\Sigma\)-orthogonal normal quotient; flatten \(v,b\) only for geometry and computation while retaining the projection \(v,b\mapsto v\) for honesty and loss; and place all nonempty component charts on one exact common rational conical refinement before defining \(\mathfrak F_{\mathfrak G,m}\).

definitions.name: Complete Gaussian-weighted gluing ledger
definitions.construction: For every \(R_f\ge0\), action functional \(f:\mathcal A\to[0,R_f]\), mean cell \(C\), incidence edge \(e=(i,j)\), protected neighborhood \(P_{C,e}\), and path load \(g_{C,e}(w)=\sum_{k:e\in\pi_C(k)}\lambda_k(w)\), define \(F_i^f(w)=\sum_{A\in\mathcal A}f(A)q_{i,A}(w)\), take \(M_{C,f}=C\cap D_v\) for coverage of \(v\) and \(M_{C,f}=C\cap H_r\) for risk, and set \(\Gamma_{C,e}^f=\sup_{h\in M_{C,f}}[\int_{P_{C,e}}g_{C,e}|F_i^f-F_j^f|\phi_{\Sigma}(w-h)\,dw+R_f\int_{P_{C,e}^{c}}g_{C,e}\phi_{\Sigma}(w-h)\,dw]\). Define \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\) as the sum of all such terms, chart errors, \(R_f\omega(h)/2\), Gaussian tails, covariance enclosures, integration enclosures, and rational rounding errors.

protected neighborhoods and outward integral enclosures

definitions.construction: \(\mathcal F(p)=\{\widetilde P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}:\widetilde P(O=j)=p_j\ \forall j\in\mathcal J\}\), where membership in \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) imposes every declared assignment, positivity, conditional-randomization, consistency and exclusion, compliance, selection-monotonicity, and target-mass restriction.

definitions.name: Finite response-type fiber polytope
definitions.construction: Enumerate \(\{\mathcal R_x:x\in\mathcal X\}\), assign weights \(\lambda_{xr}\ge0\) for \(r\in\mathcal R_x\), and define \(\Xi(p)\) by unit total mass, \(T_0\lambda=p\), stratum positivity, and always-selected-complier mass at least \(m_*\). Associate each feasible weight vector with the latent law that first draws \(X,R\) with masses \(\lambda_{xr}\), then draws \(Z\) from the known table and applies the declared consistency and exclusion maps.

definitions.name: Same-law joint quantile-effect identified set
definitions.construction: \(\Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p)=\{\Delta_P:P\in\mathcal F(p)\}\), with \(\Delta_P(t)=Q_{1,P}(t)-Q_{0,P}(t)\) for every \(t\in\mathcal T\).

definitions.name: Lower same-law endpoint construction
definitions.construction: For fixed \((p,t)\), enumerate all pairs \((j_0,j_1)\) on \(\mathcal Y\). For each pair, impose in \(\Xi(p)\) the weak threshold inequalities at \(j_0,j_1\), introduce one common slack below \(t\) for every applicable predecessor inequality, and maximize that slack; declare the pair feasible exactly when the optimum is positive, with no predecessor constraint at \(j_a=1\). Choose a feasible pair minimizing \(y_{j_1}-y_{j_0}\), choose the lexicographically least basic maximizer of its positive-slack program, and let \(P_t^-(p)\) be the induced law.

definitions.name: Upper same-law endpoint construction
definitions.construction: For fixed \((p,t)\), enumerate all pairs \((j_0,j_1)\) on \(\mathcal Y\). For each pair, impose in \(\Xi(p)\) the weak threshold inequalities at \(j_0,j_1\), introduce one common slack below \(t\) for every applicable predecessor inequality, and maximize that slack; declare the pair feasible exactly when the optimum is positive, with no predecessor constraint at \(j_a=1\). Choose a feasible pair maximizing \(y_{j_1}-y_{j_0}\), choose the lexicographically least basic maximizer of its positive-slack program, and let \(P_t^+(p)\) be the induced law.

definitions.name: External compact polyhedral-label Gaussian experiments
definitions.construction: \(\mathfrak E_K=\{(K_{\mathrm{par}},d,V,\{D_v^K=D_v\cap K_{\mathrm{par}}\}_{v\in V},\Sigma,\delta,\eta,r):\text{ass:compact-external-domain},\text{ass:compact-label-cover},\text{ass:rational-positive-covariance},\text{ass:compact-separated-domain-nonempty}\}\). Honesty, separated risk, and every parameter supremum are restricted to \(K_{\mathrm{par}}\).

definitions.name: Finite compatible moving-slack system
definitions.construction: For \(j\in\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\), use \(c_{n,j}=\sqrt n\,\psi_j\{p_n(0)\}\), \(a_j=B^{\prime}\alpha_j\), \(e_{n,j}(u)=\sqrt n[\psi_j\{p_n(u)\}-\psi_j\{p_n(0)\}]-a_j^{\prime}u\), and \(\zeta_{n,j}(u)=c_{n,j}+a_j^{\prime}u+e_{n,j}(u)\). Admissible finite limits satisfy \(c\in\mathcal K_0\), and localization at width \(\tau\) is charged by \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau)\).
inputs: the complete active cut list \(\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\)

definitions.name: Exhibited four-label facet rule
definitions.construction: Use the displayed matrices \(F_v\), whiten \(w=(a,b)\) to \(z=(a/\sqrt{1/8},b/\sqrt{3/20})\), and set \(Q_{49/25}(w)=\{v\in V_4:\min_i(F_vz)_i\ge-49/25\}\).

definitions.name: Exhibited four-label atomic dual
definitions.construction: Place risk mass \(1/2\) at each of \((1/\sqrt2,2)\) and \((-1/\sqrt2,2)\), coverage mass \(\lambda_4=90909437727/50000000000\) for each of labels \(02\) and \(12\) at \((0,2)\), and zero coverage mass for the other labels. Substitute these measures into the exact Lagrange-dual integral defining \(L_4\).

definitions.name: Exhibited four-label contact rule
definitions.construction: The rule \(K_{\mathrm{ct}}\) ignores its observation, reports all four labels with probability \(14/15\), and reports each singleton with probability \(1/60\).

statements.statement: For \(K_s(w)=E[K(w+s\Sigma^{1/2}\xi)]\), \(\xi\sim N_d(0,I_d)\), and every action functional \(f\in[0,R_f]\), \[\sup_{h\in\mathbb R^d}|E_hf\{K_s(W)\}-E_hf\{K(W)\}|\le R_f\min\{1,s^2\sqrt{d/8}\},\] and \(\|K_s(w)-K_s(w')\|_1\le\sqrt{2/\pi}\|w-w'\|_{\Sigma^{-1}}/s\).
statements.justification: The uniform kernel-independent bound converts arbitrary measurable honest rules into quantitatively gridable rules.
statements.gap: Jones and Peet smooth a discontinuous terminal cost inside a fixed Gaussian integral; they do not smooth an arbitrary randomized rule uniformly over all shifted means.
statements.consumer: The finite-rule enumeration uses this modulus to choose observation meshes without regularity assumptions on a near-minimizer.

statements.statement: For a recession stratum \(\sigma\), a \(\Sigma\)-orthogonal tangential basis \(B_{\sigma}\), and \(Q_T(w)=(2T)^{-k}\int_{[-T,T]^k}K_s(w+t u+B_{\sigma}z)\,dz\), \[\|Q_T(w+B_{\sigma}a)-Q_T(w)\|_1\le\min\{2,\|a\|_1/T\},\] and integrating out the independent residual tangential Gaussian coordinate changes any \([0,R_f]\)-valued expectation by at most \(R_fk/(T\sqrt{2\pi})\) on every declared bounded normal chart.
statements.justification: This is the quantitative local replacement step that neutralizes oscillatory behavior at infinity without assuming a recession limit.
statements.gap: Burgos Gil and Sombra control incidence geometry qualitatively, while no located statistical result supplies this rule-level tangential averaging bound.
statements.consumer: Each recession chart receives a finite normal-dimensional approximation with an explicit error allocation.

statements.statement: For the glued rule \(\widetilde K(w)=\sum_i\lambda_i(w)q_i(w)\), every mean cell \(C\), anchor \(a(C)\), specified incidence paths, and \([0,R_f]\)-valued action functional \(f\), \[|E_hF_{\widetilde K}^{f}(W)-E_hF_{a(C)}^{f}(W)|\le\sum_e\Gamma_{C,e}^{f}+R_f\omega(h)/2\] uniformly on the declared coverage or separated-risk mean domain, including means centered on seams.
statements.justification: The inequality prevents uncharged off-neighborhood and weight-variation errors from invalidating a finite gluing certificate.
statements.gap: The polyhedral compactification literature proves that charts meet correctly but has no Gaussian-weighted rule-discrepancy inequality.
statements.consumer: An independent verifier can replay every seam and path charge in the primal certificate.

statements.statement: For every \(\mathfrak G\in\mathfrak E\), the value \(M_{\mathfrak G,\eta}(r)\) is attained by a globally honest randomized rule and equals the supremum of the Lagrange dual over finite nonnegative atomic coverage measures on the regions \(D_v\) and finite atomic probability measures on \(H_r\). Every finite atomic dual is a valid lower certificate, and an increasing enumeration of rational atoms converges upward to \(M_{\mathfrak G,\eta}(r)\) without a bounded-support premise.
statements.justification: Attainment and dense atomic duality identify the exact object that the outward primal and dual programs must enclose.
statements.gap: Goldenshluger, Juditsky, and Nemirovski establish compact-convex pairwise detector saddles, and Schafer and Stark approximate compact-parameter minimax expected size; neither treats globally honest finite-label rules over an unbounded fan.
statements.consumer: CertGluePFL obtains valid lower endpoints without assuming that least-favorable mass is spatially tight.

statements.statement: There is an algorithm which, from \(\mathfrak G\in\mathfrak E\) and \(m\in\mathbb N\), outputs a finite rational class \(\mathfrak F_{\mathfrak G,m}\), one common core radius, a common recession fan refining every nonempty component \(P_{v,b}\) with all incidence maps and semantic projections, rational chart meshes, rational partitions of unity, and a computable number \(\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\downarrow0\) such that for every \(K\in\mathcal C_{\eta}\) there exists \(\widetilde K_m\in\mathfrak F_{\mathfrak G,m}\) whose semantic-label coverage is at least \(1-\eta-\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\), whose separated risk is at most \(R_r(K)+D\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\), and whose complete weighted ledger satisfies \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\le\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\).
statements.justification: This simultaneous incidence-diagram modulus is the theorem-level kernel; it turns pointwise chart approximation into a finite globally auditable search space.
statements.gap: Burgos Gil and Sombra, Kastner, Shaw, and Winz, and Jones and Peet separately provide compatible geometry or Gaussian integration, but none controls a family of statistical rules simultaneously in Gaussian-weighted risk with an input-computable modulus.
statements.consumer: The Job Corps ordered always-selected-complier workflow uses this modulus to search one common rule for the fixed assertions \(\underline\Delta(t;p)\ge0\), \(\overline\Delta(t;p)\le0\), and the lower- and upper-endpoint order comparisons over \(t<t'\), after encoding the observed cell vector, \((p_0,B)\), and \(\Sigma_0\) as \(\mathfrak G_0\).

statements.statement: Conditional on the effective-compatible-density theorem, for every \(\mathfrak G\in\mathfrak E\) and rational \(\varepsilon>0\), \(\operatorname{CertGluePFL}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\) terminates and returns a replayable globally honest primal rule, a finite rational atomic dual, outward rational endpoints \(L_{\varepsilon}\le M_{\mathfrak G,\eta}(r)\le U_{\varepsilon}\) with \(U_{\varepsilon}-L_{\varepsilon}\le\varepsilon\), and explicit total recursive bounds \(N_{\mathrm{glue}}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\), \(N_{\mathrm{cut}}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\), \(N_{\mathrm{Gauss}}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\), \(N_{\mathrm{LP}}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\), and \(\operatorname{Bit}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\) recorded in \(\mathsf C\).
statements.justification: A convergence theorem without a finite stopping recurrence would not support certified statistical practice.
statements.gap: Jones and Peet give an a priori integration error, Jungen, Djelassi, and Mitsos give conditional convergence for finite-dimensional semi-infinite programs, and Cousins and Vempala give randomized Gaussian-volume approximation; none certifies this function-valued minimax game with exact honesty and a matched atomic dual.
statements.consumer: For the Job Corps assertion list, the output archives the exact observed-cell-to-\(\mathfrak G_0\) encoding, the simultaneous honest label rule, the primal and atomic-dual objects, and every outward integration and repair charge; this replayable certificate is required because a floating-point optimizer cannot establish global honesty on tied capacity, sign, or cross-quantile faces.

statements.statement: Conditional on effective compatibility density, let \(p_n(0)=p_0\), fix a positive-support active stratum and a compact \(C\subset\mathbb R^d\) that is contained in \(\mathcal U_n\) eventually, and fix a certified rule for \(\mathfrak G_0=\mathfrak G_0(0)\) with Gaussian-null boundaries. Carter's recursive experiment-comparison kernel yields \(K_n\) whose semantic-label coverage and diameter risk converge uniformly over \(u\in C\) to their Gaussian counterparts, with an explicit remainder depending only on \(n,\kappa,C,B,\Sigma_0\), the finite active-facet count, and \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau)\).
statements.justification: This establishes the first quantitative bridge from the certified Gaussian decision to sampled categorical data.
statements.gap: Carter controls bounded losses over a fixed parameter set through total variation, but does not track changing polyhedral decision boundaries or a certified rule's integration ledger.
statements.consumer: The Job Corps cell counts are converted into one sampled-data rule for the declared sign and cross-quantile order assertions while retaining a numerical comparison receipt to the fixed encoded experiment \(\mathfrak G_0\).

statements.statement: Conditional on effective compatibility density, suppose \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), the finite vectors \(c_n\) converge to \(c\in\mathcal K_0\), and \(\sup_{u\in C,j}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) for every compact \(C\subset\mathbb R^d\). Apply CertGluePFL at a vanishing requested accuracy to the known experiment \(\mathfrak G_0(c_n)\), then transport the certified rule through Carter's positive-cell kernel. The resulting \(K_n\), which uses \(c_n\) but not the unknown limit \(c\), has semantic-label coverage deficit and separated-risk excess on \(C\) bounded by Carter's comparison error plus \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau_n)\), \(\max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|/\tau_n\), covariance and Gaussian-tail enclosures, semantic-union diameter inflation, and \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\). A computable diagonal choice \(\tau_n\downarrow0\) and certificate schedule makes this bound vanish.
statements.justification: The finite slack list, compatibility subspace, and Gaussian band charge make offset adaptation a determinate uniform theorem rather than a promissory phrase.
statements.gap: Kaido, Molinari, and Stoye calibrate drifting moment inequalities but do not transport a finite-label Gaussian minimax rule; Carter's kernel does not define or localize an active tangent arrangement.
statements.consumer: The Job Corps rule handles known root-\(n\) drifts in the capacity, generalized-inverse, and endpoint-program faces while charging every observation falling near one of the explicitly enumerated active boundaries.

statements.statement: Conditional on the effective-compatible-density theorem, every finite atomic Gaussian dual certificate is contained in a compact local direction set admitting a lawful multinomial realization whose dual value differs by the explicit positive-cell comparison remainder. With \(M_n=\inf_{K_n\in\mathcal C_{n,\eta_0}}\sup_{u\in H_{n,r_0}}E_{p_n(u)}[\ell_0\{K_n(N_n)\}]\), taking certificate accuracy to zero before exhausting compact sets yields \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}M_n\ge M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0)\), while the transferred primal rules yield the reverse \(\limsup\) inequality under the moving-offset schedule.
statements.justification: The order of limits prevents an unjustified bounded-support assumption on least-favorable dual mass.
statements.gap: Neither Carter's global deficiency statement nor compact-parameter minimax approximation identifies the two-stage certificate-then-exhaustion argument for an unbounded local fan.
statements.consumer: The Job Corps replay archive can interpret the certified \(\mathfrak G_0\) risk interval as the local multinomial minimax benchmark for the same declared assertion list, rather than as an unverified Gaussian upper approximation.

statements.statement: For the active tangent construction, \(\bigcup_{v\in V}D_v^0=\mathbb R^d\). Every \(u\) fixes a weak sign for each active hyperplane, every zero sign belongs to all incident completions, and exact projection retains a semantic label. More generally, if \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\) and a compact \(C\) has distance at least \(\tau>0\) from every offset hyperplane \(c_j+a_j^{\prime}u=0\), then the centered local expansion implies that the lawful sampled-data label on \(C\) eventually equals the label generated by \(D_v^0(c)\). At \(c=0\) this is the label fan of \(\mathfrak G_0\). When there are no active cuts, the construction reduces to one global region for the unique retained semantic label, and the honest diameter minimax value is zero.
statements.justification: This is the corrected sanity reduction: the limit fan is a global directional arrangement, not the infeasible image of \(p_0+Bu\).
statements.gap: Standard LAN arguments localize smooth statistics but do not state this completed semantic-branch cover with equality-face bookkeeping.
statements.consumer: The proposition validates \(\mathfrak G_0\)'s global cover and tells the Job Corps transfer exactly where lawful finite-sample labels coincide with the tangent encoding.

statements.statement: The globally completed active tangent arrangement has at least one full-dimensional strict chamber. The canonical search returns a chamber \(P_{v_*,b_*}^0\), rational \(u_*\), and rational Farkas certificates with \(\rho_0>0\). For \(r_0=\min\{r_{\mathrm{req}},\rho_0\}\), \(\{v:u_*\in D_v^0\}=\{v_*\}\) and \(\inf_{v\ne v_*}\inf_{g\in D_v^0}\|u_*-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}\ge r_0\). Hence \(H_{r_0}\ne\varnothing\) for \(\mathfrak G_0\) without a causal margin assumption.
statements.justification: The fixed Gaussian experiment exhibits its separated point from the completed tangent geometry instead of assuming nonemptiness or evaluating an affine vector outside the simplex.
statements.gap: The adjacent polyhedral and partial-identification results do not supply a scale-normalized rational distance certificate between semantic unions of local-limit cells.
statements.consumer: The Job Corps encoder uses this receipt to verify the separated-domain condition for \(\mathfrak G_0\) before CertGluePFL is run.

statements.statement: For every observed law \(p\), the latent laws induced by \(\lambda\in\Xi(p)\) are exactly the members of \(\mathcal F(p)\). Thus \(\Xi(p)\) is nonempty whenever \(p=p(P_0)\) for some \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), and no compatible law satisfying any declared restriction is omitted from the endpoint optimizations.
statements.justification: The endpoint programs must range over the full compatible-law fiber rather than a convenient latent subclass.
statements.gap: Adjacent Job Corps bounds do not provide the response-type fiber equivalence needed for this noncompliance, exclusion, and covariate-directional selection specification.
statements.consumer: The same-law endpoint constructions and exact local branch projection use \(\Xi(p)\) without changing the causal target.

statements.statement: For every observed law \(p=p(P_0)\) induced by some \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) and every fixed \(t\in\mathcal T\), the lower construction returns one law \(P_t^-(p)\in\mathcal F(p)\) satisfying \(Q_{1,P_t^-(p)}(t)-Q_{0,P_t^-(p)}(t)=\underline\Delta(t;p)\). Both marginal quantiles in this equality are generated by the same compatible law.
statements.justification: Separate same-law attainment makes the lower coordinate endpoint genuinely sharp rather than a difference of independently optimized marginal bounds.
statements.gap: The marginal trimming formulas do not by themselves establish attainment of their difference within one latent completion of the noncompliance-and-selection model.
statements.consumer: Each lower-endpoint sign label in the Job Corps assertion list has an auditable compatible-law witness.

statements.statement: For every observed law \(p=p(P_0)\) induced by some \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) and every fixed \(t\in\mathcal T\), the upper construction returns one law \(P_t^+(p)\in\mathcal F(p)\) satisfying \(Q_{1,P_t^+(p)}(t)-Q_{0,P_t^+(p)}(t)=\overline\Delta(t;p)\). Both marginal quantiles in this equality are generated by the same compatible law.
statements.justification: Separate same-law attainment makes the upper coordinate endpoint genuinely sharp rather than a difference of independently optimized marginal bounds.
statements.gap: The marginal trimming formulas do not by themselves establish attainment of their difference within one latent completion of the noncompliance-and-selection model.
statements.consumer: Each upper-endpoint sign label in the Job Corps assertion list has an auditable compatible-law witness.

statements.statement: For every \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) with observed law \(p=p(P_0)\), the displayed cell contrasts identify the selected-complier submeasures. The capacity formulas give valid marginal outer bounds, while \(\underline\Delta(t;p)\) and \(\overline\Delta(t;p)\) are the separate same-law infimum and supremum over \(\mathcal F(p)\), attained by \(P_t^-(p)\) and \(P_t^+(p)\). Moreover \(\Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p)\subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}[\underline\Delta(t;p),\overline\Delta(t;p)]\), with no rectangle-equality claim. For rational \((p_0,B)\), freezing nonzero base signs and retaining the active directional cuts \(\alpha_{\psi}^{\prime}Bu\) yields closed rational cells \(P_{v,b}^0\) covering all \(\mathbb R^d\), covariance \(\Sigma_0=\{B^{\prime}\operatorname{diag}(p_0)^{-1}B\}^{-1}\), and a sample-size-free \(\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E\). This global tangent construction never treats \(p_0+Bu\) as a probability law.
statements.justification: The theorem connects the abstract semantic-label experiment to coordinatewise sharp causal effect endpoints while preserving the dependence across quantiles in the full identified set.
statements.gap: Imai gives truncation-by-death quantile bounds, Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes give Job Corps average and quantile wage-effect bounds for always-employed survivors under assignment, Chen and Flores treat always-employed complier means, and Dong and Heiler (2026, Assumption 3.2 and Proposition 3.1) impose complier-conditional weak selection monotonicity and establish sharp mean bounds. None gives the same-law quantile endpoint programs and globally completed tangent label fan used here.
statements.consumer: The Job Corps analysis can report simultaneous semantic conclusions about coordinatewise sharp endpoints while separately retaining the nonrectangular same-law joint identified set.

statements.statement: Assume known conditional assignment probabilities, positive instrument and stratum support, conditional instrumental-variable randomization, the three declared consistency and exclusion conditions, no defiers, complier-conditional covariate-directional weak sample-selection monotonicity, and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\ge m_*>0\). For sampled-data transfer also impose multinomial interiority, convergence \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), and the model-specific centered local expansion. Form \(\mathcal F(p)\), compute each same-law coordinate endpoint, form the globally completed active tangent cells \(P_{v,b}^0\), and certify \(u_*\), \(\rho_0\), and \(r_0\). Apply CertGluePFL to \(\mathfrak G_0\) for the zero-offset benchmark and to the declared \(\mathfrak G_0(c_n)\) construction along moving-base sequences. Conditional on effective compatibility density, the transfer and repair theorems yield one simultaneous \(1-\eta_0\) honest semantic-label rule for every assertion in \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\), an \(\varepsilon\)-accurate Gaussian minimax certificate, and a vanishing sampled-data receipt. On compact local direction sets away from the active faces, the tangent labels equal the eventual lawful multinomial labels. No rectangular joint identified-set claim is made.
statements.justification: This is the concrete causal deliverable linking the generic unbounded-fan decision theorem to always-selected-complier multiquantile inference.
statements.gap: Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes report Job Corps average and multiple-quantile wage-effect bounds for the always-employed survivor target under assignment, while Chen and Flores incorporate noncompliance for average effects. Neither provides simultaneous semantic-label honesty for coordinatewise always-selected-complier quantile endpoints under covariate-directional selection or a replayable minimax certificate.
statements.consumer: Program evaluators and replication archives obtain a reproducible multiquantile conclusion whose full-law fiber, fixed Gaussian fan, simultaneous label rule, and outward primal-dual ledger can be replayed without selecting favorable quantiles or active faces.

statements.statement: For every external bounded experiment in \(\mathfrak E_K\), where \(K_{\mathrm{par}}\) is a nonempty compact rational polytope, \(D_v^K=D_v\cap K_{\mathrm{par}}\), and \(\bigcup_vD_v^K=K_{\mathrm{par}}\), define honesty over \(D_v^K\), separated risk over \(H_r^K\), and all parameter suprema only over \(K_{\mathrm{par}}\). Gaussian smoothing followed by rational gridding is dense for \(M_K(r)\), and outward finite-prior primal-dual programs converge to \(M_K(r)\) and terminate at every rational absolute accuracy. No recession chart, tangential average, incidence path, or recession-tail ledger is needed. This is a standalone bounded reduction and does not assert \(\mathfrak E_K\subseteq\mathfrak E\).
statements.justification: The external bounded class is the required sanity check against compact-parameter Gaussian decision theory without making an impossible global-cover claim for compact label regions.
statements.gap: This is a fidelity reduction to compact minimax confidence-set approximation, not a novelty claim and not a subclass relation to the unbounded experiment class.
statements.consumer: Compact composite-testing and minimax expected-size procedures provide regression tests for the core-only implementation in which the recession library is disabled.

statements.statement: For \(\mathfrak G_4\) at \(r=2\), the exhibited rule \(Q_{49/25}\) is globally \(0.95\)-honest because \(2\Phi(-49/25)<0.049995791\), and \(\sup_{h\in H_2}E_h\ell\{Q_{49/25}(W)\}<3/4+\arctan(\sqrt{3/10})/(2\pi)-\{\Phi(1/25)-1/2\}<0.813799\). The exact atomic dual value \(L_4\) generated by \(\beta_4\) and \(\nu_4\) exceeds \(0.361100\); its whole-line scalar reduction charges less than \(3753/10^{15}\) for replacing the optimizing multiplier by \(\lambda_4\). At \(r=0\), common-contact coverage implies risk at least \(14/15\), and \(K_{\mathrm{ct}}\) attains \(14/15\).
statements.justification: Every numerical bound now names the exact rule, atoms, weights, analytic reduction, and outward replacement charge needed for reproduction.
statements.gap: No published paper studies this four-label fan, and the rigorous enclosure width remains \(0.452699\), far above the requested milliscale gap.
statements.consumer: The explicit formulas are mandatory regression objects for every implementation of the global certificate algorithm.

statements.statement: Using the four-label bounded-test handle, construct an executable globally honest primal and a finite rational atomic dual for \(\mathfrak G_4\) at \(r=2\) whose fully outward-rounded endpoints satisfy \(U_{\varepsilon}-L_{\varepsilon}\le10^{-3}\), after charging every chart, seam, protected-neighborhood integral, tail, covariance, repair, and bit-cost term.
statements.justification: This bounded instance is an adversarial falsification test for the feasibility of the global theorem and algorithm.
statements.gap: The current rigorous interval is \([0.361100,0.813799]\); neither the literature nor the presolve provides a milliscale primal-dual gap.
statements.consumer: A successful certificate validates the complete ledger before the method is deployed on the larger Job Corps label fan.

sampling_model.design: Conditional on each fixed covariate stratum, \(Z\) is randomized with known \(\pi_z(x)=P(Z=z\mid X=x)\) and \(\min_{x,z}\{P(X=x),\pi_z(x)\}\ge\pi_*\); the observed count vector satisfies \(N_n\sim\operatorname{Multinomial}\{n,p_n(u)\}\).
sampling_model.units: The categorical support \(\mathcal J\), rational wage grid \(\mathcal Y\), rational quantile grid \(\mathcal T\), and assertion list \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\) are fixed while \(n\to\infty\).
sampling_model.treatment: The instrument \(Z\), received treatment \(D\), and selection indicator \(S\) are binary; wages are observed only when \(S=1\).
sampling_model.overlap: Carter's experiment comparison is used only on fixed positive-support multinomial strata with \(\min_j(p_0)_j\ge\kappa\). The causal bridge separately maintains randomized-instrument and stratum positivity plus aggregate \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\ge m_{*}>0\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The model-specific premises are \(p_n(0)\to p_0\) and \(\sup_{u\in C}\|\sqrt n[\{p_n(u)-p_n(0)\}]-Bu\|_2\to0\) on every compact \(C\). The fixed pair \((p_0,B)\) determines \(\Sigma_0\). Every branch inequality is evaluated at \(p_0\): nonzero signs are frozen and zero-base cuts contribute the tangent normal \(a_j=B^{\prime}\alpha_j\). Thus \(\mathfrak G_0\) covers all directions without evaluating \(p_0+Bu\) as a law. Moving faces use \(c_{n,j}=\sqrt n\psi_j\{p_n(0)\}\), the displayed remainder, the compatibility subspace \(\mathcal K_0\), and the boundary charge \(\mathfrak b_0\).

project_justification.gap: Existing geometry makes recession incidences compatible, existing numerical analysis encloses individual Gaussian-polytope integrals, and existing decision theory treats compact parameter classes. Existing Job Corps work includes average and multiple-quantile wage-effect bounds for always-employed survivors under assignment and average bounds for always-employed compliers under noncompliance. The missing theorem is a simultaneous rule-level approximation over the entire unbounded incidence diagram with one computable weighted modulus, followed by a complete primal-dual stopping recurrence and moving-face multinomial transfer for coordinatewise sharp always-selected-complier quantile-effect labels.
project_justification.niche: Finite-label partial-identification assertions create discontinuous loss and coverage constraints at intersecting faces, while least-favorable means and dual mass can escape along several incident cones. This structure is neither a compact convex hypothesis test nor a routine finite-dimensional semi-infinite program.
project_justification.fill: Nested covariance-orthogonal averaging, the explicit homogeneous recession refinement, semantic projection, weighted path accounting, repair, and atomic dual enumeration form the generic certificate program. The causal bridge uses the full complier-restricted latent fiber and a globally completed tangent fan built from active cuts at \(p_0\). The moving-offset system and four-label benchmark now have explicit finite constructions and receipts.

Jungen, Djelassi, and Mitsos (2022) show why unbounded semi-infinite discretization needs explicit convergence hypotheses. Carter (2002, Theorem 1 and Sections 2--6) supplies parameter-independent recursive multinomial--Gaussian comparison kernels under positive cells; it is not cited for the model-specific uniform triangular-array affine expansion maintained here. Kaido, Molinari, and Stoye (2019, Theorem 3.1) show how drifting active inequalities affect uniform coverage. Malloy, Tripathy, and Nowak (2021, Definition 1 and Theorem 1) give minimum-average-volume exact multinomial confidence sets; this is an informed finite-sample benchmark rather than a claimed extension target. Chen and Flores (2015, Propositions 1--2) treat Job Corps always-employed complier means under noncompliance. Dong and Heiler (2026, Assumption 3.2, Proposition 3.1, and Theorem 4.1) impose complier-conditional weak selection monotonicity, establish sharp mean SLATE bounds for always-selected compliers, and give inference with joint asymptotic normality. The causal contribution here instead targets the always-selected-complier quantile-effect vector on a finite quantile grid under noncompliance and covariate-directional selection, defines coordinatewise sharp endpoints through same-law fiber optimizations, and supplies simultaneous semantic-label honesty with replayable minimax certification. The closest decision results are Goldenshluger, Juditsky, and Nemirovski (2015) and Schafer and Stark (2009), whose compact parameter sets exclude escaping primal constraints and dual mass. Carter (2002) transports bounded decisions only after a fixed positive-support experiment is specified; the proposal additionally derives one moving-offset rule and orders certificate approximation before compact exhaustion. For the causal consumer, Imai (2008) supplies truncation-by-death quantile bounds, Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes (2013, Section 5, Proposition 1, and Section 6.4) supply Job Corps always-employed survivor average and multiple-quantile bounds under assignment, Chen and Flores (2015) address always-employed complier means under noncompliance, and Dong and Heiler (2026, Assumption 3.2, Proposition 3.1, and Theorem 4.1) establish sharp mean SLATE bounds and inference for always-selected compliers under complier-conditional weak selection monotonicity. The present causal bridge instead targets a finite-grid quantile-effect semantic-label object, defines the full latent-law fiber for always-selected compliers under noncompliance and covariate-directional selection, obtains each fixed-quantile effect endpoint through a separate same-law optimization, retains only Cartesian-product containment for the joint vector, and builds simultaneous semantic labels with replayable minimax certification. None of these causal comparators contains the unbounded recession-compatible rule-density theorem or the moving-face Gaussian-to-multinomial certification kernel.
